company.description: DisputeNinja provides AI-powered chargeback management software for software and AI startups. The company focuses on automating chargeback defense and revenue recovery by integrating with payment processors such as Stripe. Its platform uses autonomous agents to collect transaction evidence via APIs or browser agents, generate contextual dispute narratives, and assemble tailored responses for card networks and issuers. DisputeNinja is designed for lean finance, operations, and fraud teams that need to handle high volumes of disputes without scaling manual headcount. The software consolidates chargeback workflows into a unified interface, helping teams manage cases from notification through submission. DisputeNinja also supports recurring billing and subscription-related disputes, offering content and tooling specific to common chargeback reason codes.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-driven chargeback management platform that automates evidence collection, dispute drafting, and chargeback response submission.
